Fieldwork

Mobility looks different from the street.

FIELDWORK by Earth5R takes students out of the classroom and into their own neighbourhoods to study real problems in transport and the built environment and work with the community, with a mentor checking the work along the way. Before the next brochure, walk the block that cars actually use.

Learn more at earth5r.org
jobs_ad_html: Fieldwork Want a portfolio that knows how people actually move through a city? FIELDWORK by Earth5R is a mentored fellowship where school and university students study real neighbourhood mobility problems with the community, and every piece of work is verified. earth5r.org/fieldwork
